mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) can cause acute kidney injury which impairs renal clearance of semaglutide metabolites and increases risk of semaglutide accumulation; semaglutide's effects on gastric motility may alter amikacin absorption.
action: Monitor renal function closely during concurrent use; assess amikacin necessity and consider alternatives; monitor for signs of semaglutide accumulation or adverse effects.
